_comment: OPTIONAL. If this file is absent the dashboard reads RPC credentials
straight out of ~/.wam/wam.conf, which install.sh generates. In the normal
case there is nothing to configure -- just run `node server.js`.
Copy to config.json only if you need to override something.
_bind: 127.0.0.1 keeps the dashboard local. Change to 0.0.0.0 ONLY behind a TLS reverse proxy.
_explorerRequestsPerMinute: Per-caller ceiling on /api/* in any 60-second window, keyed on the socket address. /api/health is never refused, because monitoring polls it. 120 is two a second, well above a browser refreshing several panels. Raise it when a reverse proxy fronts the dashboard: every request then arrives from the proxy and shares one bucket. Until 2026-11-26 this key was accepted and ignored -- the loader dropped it and the limiter used its own default -- which is why it is written down here now.
_seedHostnames: Seed names without the x9. prefix, for the network panel. Leave it out to use this project's own seeds.
